u-menus BACKEND — upload to https://backend.u-menus.com/

node_modules is already inside this zip. Do not run npm on the server.

Shared hosting cannot start Node by unzipping only. Do these three host actions once:

1) MySQL (phpMyAdmin)
   - Create a database + user
   - Import data/almenupro.sql into that database

2) Put this extracted folder in your Node app directory
   - Rename env.example to .env
   - Fill MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, MYSQL_DATABASE (usually MYSQL_HOST=localhost)

3) cPanel → Setup Node.js App
   - Application URL: backend.u-menus.com
   - Application root: this folder
   - Startup file: apiServer.js
   - Node version: 22 (or 20)
   - Restart

Check: https://backend.u-menus.com/api/health
Expect: "storage":"mysql"

Login UI is NOT on the backend. Open https://u-menus.com/admin
Default superadmin is SUPER_ADMIN_USER / SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env
